refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: The ne_sock_set_intr function registers a callback which is invoked whilst waiting for the socket to become ready during a blocking read or connect operation. If the callback returns non-zero, the operation in progress is abandoned and fails with NE_SOCK_INTR. If fn is &null;, any callback previously registered for the socket is removed.

The callback is invoked from inside the blocking operation, and may be invoked repeatedly — at least once a second — for a single operation. It must therefore return promptly, must not block, and must not perform any operation on the socket.

refsect1.title: Notes
refsect1.para: Write operations are not interruptible, and the callback is not invoked for a read which can be satisfied from the socket's internal read buffer.

For an SSL/TLS connection, the callback is only consulted whilst waiting for data to arrive on the socket. A read which is blocked inside the TLS library waiting for the remainder of a partially received record is not interruptible, nor is the TLS handshake.

Subject to those exceptions, since the callback is consulted at least once a second, a blocking operation is abandoned within approximately one second of the callback beginning to return non-zero, regardless of whether the platform delivers an EINTR to interrupt the wait.

refsect1.title: Return value
refsect1.para: The ne_sock_set_intr function returns no value.

refsect1.title: History
refsect1.para: ne_sock_set_intr is available in &neon; 0.38.0 and later.
